description: This file defines API routes for a web application built with FastAPI. It handles CSV file uploads, session management, dataset status retrieval, and column selection/normalization for energy usage data. The routes facilitate uploading CSVs, creating or retrieving sessions, checking dataset status, and processing datasets by selecting relevant columns and normalizing energy units. The session store is used to maintain in-memory state across requests.

classes.name: SessionInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a user session, including session ID and timestamps.

classes.name: DatasetStatusResponse
classes.description: Response model indicating whether dataset payload exists, with a preview.

classes.name: CsvUploadPreviewResponse
classes.description: Response structure after uploading CSV, including schema, preview, and warnings.

classes.name: DatasetSelectColumnsResponse
classes.description: Response after selecting dataset columns and normalization, including summary and preview.

methods.name: str _ensure_session(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str])
methods.description: Ensures a session exists and sets a cookie if a new session is created.

methods.name: SessionInfo get_session(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None))
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a session info object for the current user.

methods.name: DatasetStatusResponse get_dataset_status(response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None))
methods.description: Returns the status of the dataset payload for the current session.

methods.name: CsvUploadPreviewResponse upload_dataset_csv( response: Response, file: UploadFile = File(..., description="CSV file containing electricity/energy usage data."), vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None), )
methods.description: Handles CSV file upload, parsing, cleaning, and session storage of preview info.

methods.name: DatasetSelectColumnsResponse select_dataset_columns_and_normalize( request: DatasetSelectColumnsRequest, response: Response, vs_session_id: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None), )
methods.description: Processes user-selected columns and units to normalize energy data, storing the processed dataset in session.
